div.div: Other devices: their access tokens die with the old token_version, and replaying a refresh token ended by revoke-all (or from an older token_version) gets 401 session_expired without revoking again, so the session started after the reset survives; reusing a rotated token still revokes all. Code TTL, attempts, resend wait and hourly cap reuse the identity otp_* keys; forgot/reset rate limits come from migrations 0011 and 0012. Wrong-code, used-code and unknown-number answers are indistinguishable.

a.text: Text is not SVG - cannot display
